item.text: The advisory lookup also routes every Amazon release other than 2 or 2022 to the Linux 1 database. I’ll use the existing version normalization for both lookup paths, and cover release parsing, advisory links, and support date boundaries with tests.

# Checkpoint

Task: support Amazon Linux 2023, 2025, 2027, and 2029 detection, advisory lookup, and EOL dates.

Findings:
- config/os.go treats every single-token Amazon release as version 1; EOL lookup stops at 2022.
- scanner/redhatbase.go recognizes only 2022 and 2 in /etc/system-release parsing.
- oval/util.go routes all other Amazon releases to the version 1 advisory database in both HTTP and DB paths.
- oval/redhat.go builds advisory source links only for ALAS2022, ALAS2, and ALAS.

Next: patch these paths and add focused tests, then run existing Go package tests with network access disabled.
EOF"
